title: keybindingspage
summary: MSUI implements a standalone 1.12-style Key Bindings window (Program.Keybindings.cs): six-piece UI-KeyBindingFrame art, category headers, 17-row scrolling list with vanilla scrollbar, dual key capsules per command, click-to-arm capture, silent key-steal from other commands, Unbind, Reset To Default, Okay/Cancel with snapshot revert, and a Character Specific Key Bindings checkbox. Benilla instead embeds keybindings as an Options-window category (era 1.15 structure, live-commit, collapsible sections, search).

openItems.text: No modifier-chord capture: FirstBindableKeyDown binds bare keys only - ALT-/CTRL-/SHIFT-key combinations cannot be bound
No mouse button (3/4/5) or mouse-wheel binding capture
Character Specific Key Bindings checkbox is cosmetic: _characterSpecificBindings is never read by SaveBindings/LoadBindings - no per-character binding set exists
Stealing a key silently unbinds its previous owner with no KEY_UNBOUND_ERROR-style red warning naming the victim
Category headers are plain labels - no collapse/expand sections and no binding search
